posts.text:
NBA Cup group play wraps up Friday, and margins matter.

Tied in a group? Tiebreakers: head-to-head, then group-play point differential, then total points scored. An overtime game counts as a 0 differential for both teams.

East Group A: Orlando finished 3-1; Toronto and Detroit (2-1) each have one game left (as of Nov. 25).

Evidence-first NBA: https://www.mosport.app/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=trend_radar_v1&utm_content=nba-cup-tiebreakers

Every point counts in NBA Cup group play. Overtime points don't.

If teams finish tied in a group, the tiebreakers run:
1. Head-to-head
2. Group-play point differential
3. Total points scored

An overtime game is recorded as a 0 point differential for both teams.

East Group A: Orlando has finished 3-1; Toronto and Detroit (both 2-1) each have one game left (as of Nov. 25). Final group games are Friday, Nov. 27 (ET).

Source: NBA.com, Emirates NBA Cup rules. Evidence-first NBA coverage from MOSPORT. Link in bio.
